_comment: Single source of truth for public release metadata. Copy to PublicIdentity.local.json (gitignored) to override with real values once known. Never commit real legal/security identity here. Website/generate.py reads this file, then overlays the local one key by key, so the local file only needs to carry what it actually overrides.
_placeholders: Any value of the form [SOMETHING_TO_DEFINE] renders literally on the site inside a placeholder-token span, so Scripts/check-placeholders.sh can find it and block a production deploy. That is deliberate: the site must never present a reassuring legal page over an undefined publisher or an undefined security contact.
_siteIndexableComment: Enabled after the production deployment and custom domain were verified reachable over HTTPS on 2026-07-27. Website/generate.py reads this for page metadata, robots.txt and Vercel headers so they cannot disagree.
_hostComment: Host details are public corporate information published by the host itself, not personal data, so they are tracked here rather than in the local file. Verified 2026-07-27 from Vercel's own Terms of Service (vercel.com/legal/terms), which names this address for service of legal notice.
hostAddress: 440 N Barranca Ave #4133, Covina, CA 91723, United States
_publisherComment: publisherOfRecord is the individual publishing the site. It is NOT a company: see Documentation/LEGAL_IDENTITY_DETERMINATION.md for why this launch is classified as non-professional, and what would have to change for that to stop being true. legalAddress is intentionally absent from the public site — under LCEN Art. 6 III-2 a non-professional publisher may withhold their personal address provided the host holds their identity.
